kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Clipping of نَرْدَشِير (nardašīr) or from Persian نرد (nard).

# نَرُدَّ (narudda) /na.rud.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of رَدَّ (radda)
